title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-11
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96] > (see notes)
source: 1 x Sony Microphone => Sony Portable Cassette Recorder [Monophonic] >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent mono audience tape with warm, crystal‑clear sound captures a short but sweet early‑Dead set highlighted by a smoking Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) capture from a single stage mic that sounds remarkably warm and detailed for a 1969 source—many reviewers call it the best‑sounding ’69 AUD they’ve heard. Musically the show, though brief, delivers classic early‑Dead energy with a standout Dark Star and notable moments like a Bach excerpt and the French Suite Allemande, making it a prized listen despite being incomplete.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both sound quality (warm, clear mono AUD) and performance (smoking Dark Star, vintage early‑Dead vibe); numerous 5‑star reviews give strong confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono recording from a single stage DFC mic; warm ambient ambiance; very clear for the era. Synthetic MS‑stereo version exists but not used here.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short, sweet early‑Dead set with vintage ambience; flow is loose but enjoyable, capturing the raw energy of late‑1969.
